summary: Recruitment eligibility after criminal acquittal involving moral turpitude; disclosure of prior case during verification; acquittal not bar to rejection; standard: suitability for police service; departmental discretion not arbitrary; High Court's remand overturned; moral turpitude in POCSO Act offences; Avtar Singh precedent applied.
legal_provisions_cited: Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act, 2012 s.7; s.8; s.11(d); s.12
Indian Penal Code s.341; s.354(d); s.323; s.34
Madhya Pradesh Uchcha Nyayalaya (Khand Nyayapeeth Ko Appeal) Adhiniyam, 2005
final_judgment: Appeal allowed; High Court judgment set aside; recruitment rejection restored.
